notes: Seed URL and homepage on www.co.la-salle.tx.us returned HTTP 500 to the fetch module (2 Oct 2026). One web search found the elections department pages on www.co.la-salle.tx.us (unreachable, 500) and on lasallecountytx.com. The lasallecountytx.com Election Information and Elections Department pages load but list results only through November 2023 (Nov_23_Unofficial_Results.pdf, OFFICIAL_Canvass_Results-11-20-2023.pdf) and 2024 primary filing notices; nothing for the three target elections. Their Last-Modified header equals the request time (dynamic page, no upload evidence). No Clarity site (elections.json 404 for 'La Salle'). Check 3 pending. Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-L): No change. The site now answers at https://co.la-salle.tx.us (no www). Its per-election pages list files for all three elections (2024: 'Unofficial Results', official per-precinct files; 2026 primary: 'Cumulative Unofficial Results', SOS unofficial reports, and 'Local Elections Unofficial Results' image; runoff: 'Cumulative Results Report', SOS unofficial reports), but every file is under /images/, which robots.txt disallows ('Disallow: /images/'), so none could be opened or timed (accepted, not bypassed). The wayback branch has an election-night capture (2026-03-04 00:44 CST) of the article '2026 Primary Elections Local Results' (datePublished 2026-03-03T22:19:29-06:00) whose body is only an image, /images/images/Local_Unofficial_Results.jpg; the image itself was not saved and Wayback replay was unreachable, so its content (county totals or precinct numbers) is unknown. Election-night captures of the election-board page show no results links. Wayback (web.archive.org) was unreachable from the fetch module throughout this pass (robots.txt request reset: 'Connection reset by peer'), so no new archive lookups were possible; sweep not expected for this county.
